accurate strike.name: Accurate Strike ([[2]] arcane pool, swift): all your melee attacks resolve as melee touch attacks until the end of your turn

arcane accuracy.name: Arcane Accuracy ([[1]] arcane pool, swift): insight bonus to all attack rolls until the end of your turn

true strike.name: True Strike ki power ([[1]] ki, self): insight bonus on your next attack roll; ignore concealment miss chance

offensive defense.name: Offensive Defense: on a sneak attack hit, gain +[[floor((@classes.rogue.level + 1) / 2)]] dodge AC against that creature for [[1]] round

powerful sneak.name: Powerful Sneak (full attack only): sneak attack dice treat rolled 1s as 2s
